notes.title: Patch 26/07/2024
notes.content:
Improvements and Bug Fixes
We are happy to announce that we have released a new update to improve the gaming experience for owners of 21:9 ultra-wide monitors. Thanks to your feedback, we have identified and fixed a number of issues. Here are the main fixes:

Fixed an alignment issue: Menus and user interfaces now properly adapt to the 21:9 resolution, avoiding off-screen or poorly positioned elements.
Fix for cutscene display: Cinematic scenes now play without cuts or distortions, ensuring an immersive visual experience even on ultra-wide monitors.
Performance optimizations: Performance improvements to ensure a stable framerate even in high resolutions.
Please continue to send us your feedback and reports. We are committed to making the game better for all of you. Enjoy!

notes.title: fixes based on your feedback
notes.content:
[h1]THANK U ALL[/h1]

As a developer, I care deeply about the community of our games. We've been listening to your feedback in the reviews and are excited to announce a new update that includes:

[b]Removal of the anti-auto clicker.[/b]

we have seen many complaints about the presence of the anti auto clicker and we have decided that every player will be free to experience the game as they like

[b]Balancing of power-ups for a fairer gameplay experience.[/b]

Balancing an autoclicker is not easy at all, so over time we followed the reviews and continued to balance to make the upgrades more satisfying

[b]Fixing phrases in various languages that didn't have initial capital letters in dialogues.[/b]

We noticed that some subtitles in the dialogue did not have the initial letter capitalized and this has been fixed.

[h1]conclusions[/h1]

It's the first time we've seen so many negative and dissatisfied reviews that we decided to do a general rework hoping that your opinion about the game can improve positively.
Thank you all for your attention and have a good game!
